evidence.quote: The study program is taught 100% in English.
Please note: EU citizens pay no tuition fees, for non-EU citizens the tuition fee is 1500 EUR per semester.
Apply online for the English Bachelor program in "Electrical Engineering and Information Technology".
All applicants must hand in the following application documents: 1. School completion certificate (certified and transcripted)
2. English language certificate An English language certificate is required for all international applicants (TOEFL certificate with at least ibt 83, or an equivalent English test).
3. German language certificate (Level A1) Proof of German language proficiency must be provided no later than 6 weeks after the start of lectures.

note.fr: Les candidats non-UE doivent demander un certificat ASK (Ausländerstudienkolleg Konstanz) ; contactez l'ASK très tôt car les délais diffèrent.
note.en: Non-EU applicants must obtain an ASK certificate (Ausländerstudienkolleg Konstanz); contact the ASK as early as possible as deadlines differ.

evidence.quote: Non-EU applicants only: ASK certificate. The Studienkolleg of Konstanz University of Applied Sciences (Center for International Students at HTWG Konstanz) is responsible for issuing these certificates.

notes: L'ASK-Zertifikat est spécifique aux candidats non-UE et n'est pas un document universitaire habituel ; il est listé comme manual_check, pas comme document. Le portail d'application est le portail propre de l'université (application en ligne) ; aucune mention d'uni-assist dans les pages.
